mapper.select: SELECT S.sub_seq, S.cur_seq, S.sub_name, S.start_date, S.end_date, S.status, S.reg_id, S.reg_date, S.update_id, S.update_date, S.account_seq, A.account_name AS teacherName FROM lms.tb_subject S LEFT OUTER JOIN lms.tb_account A ON S.account_seq = A.account_seq WHERE S.cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND S.status != 'D' ORDER BY S.start_date ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT currval('lms.tb_subject_sub_seq_seq')
INSERT INTO lms.tb_subject ( cur_seq, sub_name, start_date, end_date, status, reg_id, reg_date, account_seq ) VALUES ( #{curSeq}, #{subName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{accountSeq} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lms.tb_subject SET sub_name = #{subName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, account_seq = #{accountSeq, jdbcType=INTEGER}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sub_seq = #{subSeq}
